approvedTakeOut.finding: The NPS layer identifies Gilbert as one of the primary river accesses. This is a managed access-area anchor, not a surveyed water-edge coordinate; follow current signs and inspect the public gravel-bar approach on arrival.

routeGeometryReview.finding: The regenerated route follows one connected Buffalo River network trace between the Tyler Bend upper launch and the NPS Gilbert access-area anchor. Both endpoint audit results are review-only; neither is suspicious, a failure, or unknown.
